issue.name: Content security policy is not configured
issue.issueDetail: The synthetic training response did not include a Content-Security-Policy header.
issue.remediationDetail: Define a restrictive policy and validate it in report-only mode before enforcement.

issue.name: Server version disclosed by response header
issue.issueDetail: The lab service returned a detailed synthetic Server header.
issue.remediationDetail: Return a generic server identifier and keep exact component versions in the internal inventory.
